about.title: About Bike Bali Rent
about.p1: Bike Bali Rent is a motorbike rental service in Bali. We help travellers and long-stay guests get around the island on a well-kept scooter or motorbike, with delivery to your door and a simple online booking.
about.p2: We keep the rental straightforward: a clear price up front, helmets and accessories available, and optional theft and damage protection. There's no online prepayment — you pay when your bike is delivered.
offer: A range of bikes — from 160cc scooters to sport and touring models
Flexible rental length, day to month and beyond

faq.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.intro: Everything you need to know before you book. Got another question? Message us on WhatsApp or Telegram.

items.a: Yes — we deliver across the main tourist areas near Denpasar: Bukit, Canggu, Seseh, Ubud, Denpasar, Sanur and nearby. Other areas on request. The delivery fee depends on how long you rent — it's better value on longer rentals, and you'll see the exact price at checkout. Share a Google Maps link when you book so the driver knows where to go.
Yes — a refundable deposit is held during the rental and returned when you bring the bike back in good condition. The amount depends on the model, and you'll see it at checkout.

Yes, optionally. You can add theft protection and/or damage protection at checkout. The price depends on the coverage level you choose and your rider profile (age and riding experience) — you'll see the exact price at checkout.
Yes — just message us before your current rental ends. You pay for the extension by the end of the current period.

items.q: Is there a minimum or maximum rental period?
items.a: No minimum and no maximum — rent from a single day to as long as you like.

items.q: What do I need to rent?
items.a: Just a photo of your passport — nothing else.

items.q: How do I pay? Is there online payment?
items.a: There's no online payment. You pay when the bike is delivered or handed over. Booking online simply reserves your bike and sends your request to our team.

Every bike comes with 2 helmets free. You can upgrade either slot to a KYT full-face helmet, or to a brand-new KYT half-face or full-face helmet, from Rp 150,000 (Rp 200,000 for the new full-face). A rear top box for a passenger is available for Rp 200,000. Just pick what you need at checkout.
Pick a bike, choose your dates and extras to see the price, then send a request. Our manager confirms the details with you on WhatsApp or Telegram.
